This is a list of chapters of the {{OBP|Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl|Sakai Takayuki}} manga created by 坂井 孝行 Sakai Takayuki. Altogether, there are 29 chapters. Currently, the Pocket Monsters Diamond & Pearl manga has not been translated into English by either [[VIZ Media]] or [[Chuang Yi]].
